headline: Foseco India Limited announces sale of subsidiary company shares
sum: Foseco India Limited has informed the NSE of a general update regarding the sale of shares in a subsidiary company. The disclosure was filed as a regulatory update under Regulation 30 of the SEBI LODR.
implication: Divestment of subsidiary equity triggers mandatory continuous disclosure under SEBI LODR Regulation 30; material subsidiary status and valuation will determine if deemed 'material event' requiring pre-announcement board approval and disclosure timing rules.
detail: Foseco India Limited, an Indian industrial company, has made a regulatory announcement to the NSE regarding the sale of shares in a subsidiary company. The specific subsidiary, sale price, and transaction terms have not been disclosed in the filed regulatory update. The announcement is made under Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, which requires material events to be disclosed to stock exchanges on a continuous basis. Further details regarding the transaction structure, valuation, buyer identity, and closing timeline are pending.
